description_en: Queries virus scheduled scan policies under the current Alibaba Cloud account with paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下的病毒定时扫描策略
name: ListVirusScanScheduledStrategies

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The collection of scan path scopes. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 扫描的路径范围集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: scan_modes

parameters.help_en: The collection of scan performance modes. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 扫描性能模式集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: performance_modes

parameters.help_en: The collection of virus scheduled scan policy IDs. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 病毒定时扫描策略ID集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: strategy_ids

parameters.help_en: The policy name. Fuzzy match is supported. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 策略名称，支持模糊查询。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及半角句点（.）、下划线（_）、连字符（-）
parameters.name: strategy_name

parameters.help_en:
Filters policies by enabled status. Valid values:
Enabled: enabled.
Disabled: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
按启用状态过滤。取值：
Enabled：已启用。
Disabled：已停用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The user group ID. This parameter is used to filter policies whose effective scope includes the specified user group. You can obtain the value from:
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~): lists user groups
parameters.help_zh:
用户组ID，用于筛选生效范围包含该用户组的策略。取值来源：
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~)：批量查询用户组
parameters.name: user_group_id
